title: SejioMedia
description: Watch YouTube videos in Minecraft using a placeable Display Frame block, with full audio playback.
body:
# SejioMedia

Watch YouTube videos inside Minecraft using a placeable **Media Screen block**, 
complete with full audio playback. Place the block, right-click, paste a YouTube 
URL, and hit Play — no external setup required.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- **Windows only**

## Limitations
- **Singleplayer-only**
- Early release, expect bugs

## Legal
This mod downloads yt-dlp and FFmpeg at runtime. Users are responsible for 
ensuring their usage complies with the terms of any content they stream.
